changelog:
Each injection pass is now built from isolated steps. Until now a phase ran as one block: if a single modification threw — typically a NoSuchMethodError or NoClassDefFoundError after a CloudStream update — every later modification of that phase was silently skipped, and the log only said "Phase N error" without naming the feature. A failing step is now named, and the remaining steps still run, so one broken feature no longer hides the rest of the screen.
The diagnostics dashboard names the failing step: phase, step and error, plus how many steps failed in this session. The injection card also shows how many steps a pass executed, and the review report lists the failures per step (which feature to fix) and the slowest steps.
The per-module cost list in the injection summary was declared but never filled, so it always read as empty. Every step now records its duration, and the list is bounded so a long session cannot grow it.
message: Dev build v871 - one broken injection step no longer takes the rest of the screen with it
